resource_ledger.note: Complete allocated ELF sections remain listed above. accounting_note: RAM includes resident IRAM/DRAM and reserved stack/storage, not alias gaps. Embassy has no app heap; async futures/task headers are static and are included. Flash is load-bearing ELF bytes; merged-image length also contains bootloader/alignment. Baseline subtraction does not make the platforms feature-equivalent. Energy is not measured.
